name: D.O.I. Brückner-Collet
evidence: Expanded initials: D.O.I. Brueckner-Collet = Daan Oriah Israel Brueckner-Collet (SSRN author page 'Daan Oriah Israel Brueckner-Collet', papers.ssrn.com/sol3/cf_dev/AbsByAuth.cfm?per_id=7230822), initials match exactly; co-author of Selma Rudert on ostracism work, formerly RPTU/Koblenz-Landau social psychology, now M.Sc. academic staff in Oliver Dickhaeuser's group, Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Mannheim (sowi.uni-mannheim.de/dickhaeuser/team/.../m-sc-daan-brueckner-collet/). LinkedIn: two site:linkedin.com/in searches for 'Brueckner-Collet'/'Brueckner-Collet Mannheim psychology' returned only unrelated Brueckner namesakes and company pages - no profile with this hyphenated surname, so not found. ResearchGate: site:researchgate.net/profile search for the surname returned no profile for him (he appears only as a co-author on Rudert's and Kenntemich's pages), so not found. Email: the Mannheim page is blocked by the egress proxy; two search summaries produced two DIFFERENT addresses for him (…@mail.uni-mannheim.de vs …@uni-mannheim.de), which shows they were reconstructed rather than quoted, so no address is treated as printed/verified.
